home.about.headline: Tarot Tree
home.about.text1: Tarot Tree is a digital space for Tarot, Runes and Lenormand.
home.about.text2: A meditative Focus view, a panoramic Spread view, and an AI Oracle that ties your questions and cards into one coherent reading.
home.about.text3: A full astrological almanac with natal charts, synastry and seven-day transits — it even works offline.
about.mission: Tarot Tree was born from a wish to bring the tactile magic of physical decks together with the analytical power of today.
about.meaningText: A deck is a way of slowing down: shuffling, laying out cards, reading what they show you about your question.
about.tired: Too many esoteric apps turn a deck into a slot machine — endless upsells, paywalled meanings, stock interpretations.
about.goodNews: We wanted a place where you can slow down. Where the deck obeys your fingers — thanks to our Focus view physics — and readings go beyond book clichés.

about.tableIntro: This project grew out of a simple wish: a calm, private space for looking for answers.
about.goal: We build a place where the cards, the stars and your own questions meet — quietly, and only for you.
about.howText1: Pick a deck — Tarot, Runes or Lenormand — and ask your question.
about.howText2: Shuffle in the Focus view, or lay the cards out across the panoramic Spread view.
about.howText3: The AI Oracle reads your question and the cards together, and turns them into one coherent answer.
values.intro: We built Tarot Tree on Zero-Knowledge principles. No collecting personal data, no leaking your diary.
values.notRules: Not rules for the sake of rules — the boundaries that keep this place quiet.
values.next: Here is what that means in practice.
values.p1.text: Your natal chart, your spread history and your talks with the Oracle stay encrypted on your device. We never see what you ask the cards — and we do not need that data to make money. Your diary is your fortress.
values.p2.text: Tarot Tree never predicts fatal outcomes and never programs for negativity. The cards are a projective, psychological tool for finding inner balance.
values.p3.text: A spread reflects your question back to you. It does not decide your future for you — you do.
values.p4.text: There is no analytics, no fingerprinting and no ads in the code. Your readings never leave your device.
values.p5.text: The almanac and your saved readings work without a connection. Nothing about you needs to reach a server.
values.p6.text: No selling your data, no ad profiles built on your searches. The project lives on honest support, not on you.
values.p7.text: Tarot Tree is not medicine and not therapy. For health or money decisions, talk to a real specialist.
values.p8.text: Anyone can read the code and run their own copy. Transparency is a property of the product, not a promise.
values.p9.text1: We are fully transparent about what the app does.
values.p9.text2: The Oracle is clearly labelled as AI and never pretends to be a person.
values.hear.text: The cards and the Oracle are tools. The meaning — and the choice — are always yours.
values.hearReady: There is always room for people who listen to themselves

safety.nowText: Tarot Tree is built on Zero-Knowledge principles. We collect no personal data, and your diary never leaks.
safety.callText: Tarot Tree does not predict fatal outcomes and does not program for negativity. We use the cards as a projective, psychological tool for finding inner balance.
safety.stepsTitle: How we keep the cards safe
safety.step1: Your natal chart, spread history and Oracle dialogues are encrypted on your device.
safety.step2: We do not know what you ask the cards — and we do not need that data to make money.
safety.step3: There is no analytics, no fingerprinting and no ads in the code.
safety.step4: The Oracle is clearly labelled as AI and never pretends to be a person.
safety.step5: Everything works offline — nothing about you needs to reach a server.
safety.notHereText: No ad trackers, no behavioral analytics, no paywalled meanings. Your readings stay on your device.
safety.longTermText: Tarot Tree is not medicine and not a replacement for therapy. If something is weighing on you, a real specialist is the right next step. Asking for help is normal.

meta.privacy.description: What Tarot Tree keeps on your device and what it never touches: Zero-Knowledge, no trackers, no behavioral analytics.
privacy.stored.telegramId: Nothing about your account is required to read the cards. No registration, no name.
privacy.lead: People bring their questions, their doubts and their natal charts here. So the project is direct about data: what stays on your device, and where the boundaries are.
privacy.stored.session: Your spreads and their history — encrypted, and they never leave your device.
privacy.stored.alias: Your natal chart and personal transits — computed locally, never uploaded.
privacy.stored.email: Your dialogues with the Oracle — they exist only on your device.
privacy.stored.stories: Your saved readings and diary entries — yours alone, encrypted at rest.
privacy.stored.voice: We keep nothing server-side by default: there is no server-side copy of your readings.
privacy.stored.notifications: If you choose notifications, they stay on your device and never leave it.
privacy.stored.solana: An optional wallet address for supporting the project — shared only if you choose to.
privacy.notHere.ip: IP addresses. The code never writes them down.
privacy.notHere.userAgent: Your User-Agent — never read, never stored.
privacy.notHere.logs: Access logs with IPs and User-Agents — in production we write a privacy-first format.
privacy.notHere.analytics: Google Analytics, Yandex.Metrica, Sentry profiles — no behavioral analytics.
privacy.notHere.likes: Likes and view counters — they don't exist in the data model.
privacy.notHere.keys: Your private keys and payments. Money travels wallet to wallet; the platform sees only a status.
privacy.retention.voice: Your Oracle dialogues stay only as long as you keep them on your device.
privacy.retention.video: Nothing is uploaded, so nothing needs to be deleted from a server.
privacy.retention.session: Your session lives in a local cookie — behind it there is nothing but your own device.
privacy.verifyTitle: You should not have to take our word for it
privacy.verify.registration: No feature requires registration. Reading the cards needs no account at all.
privacy.verify.data: The app holds no real names, phone numbers, locations or social graphs.
privacy.verify.code: The code holds no pixels, no ads, no browser fingerprinting.
privacy.verify.practices: Your readings and the almanac run right on your device and never leave it.
privacy.verify.selfHosted: Every line above is a property of the code, not a promise. The platform is self-hostable: run your own instance and look at the tables yourself.
